name: MonarchFavoritesList
title: FavoritesList
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.NavigationDrawerItem for the rows, with MonarchReorderableList (androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn) in edit mode and androidx.compose.ui.semantics.CustomAccessibilityAction for removal outside edit mode
summary: A navigation section of pinned destinations with a heading, the current destination marked, and an Edit button that turns on reorder and remove.
whenToUse: For the person's pinned projects, views or documents at the top of a navigation drawer or rail, where the app stores the favourites.
whenNotToUse: For the app's fixed destinations use NavigationDrawerItem or NavigationSuiteScaffold directly. To pin or unpin the current screen use a FilledTonalIconToggleButton with a star (ToggleButton), not this list.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchFavoritesList(items: List<MonarchFavoriteItem>, onSelect: (MonarchFavoriteItem) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, editing: Boolean? = null, onEditingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, onRemove: ((MonarchFavoriteItem) -> Unit)? = null, onReorder: ((List<MonarchFavoriteItem>) -> Unit)? = null, headingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchFavoritesListLabels = MonarchFavoritesListLabels())
public class MonarchFavoriteItem(title: String, id: String, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, current: Boolean = false)

public class MonarchFavoritesListLabels(title: String? = null, edit: String? = null, editLabel: String? = null, done: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeLabel: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, removed: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, reorder: MonarchReorderableListLabels = MonarchReorderableListLabels())

options.name: items
options.description: The pinned destinations, in order. current marks the screen the person is on; items are equal when their ids are.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Opens a destination when its row is tapped outside edit mode.

options.name: editing
options.description: Edit mode controlled by the app. null lets the section keep it, starting off.

options.name: onEditingChange
options.description: Called when Edit or Done is tapped, and with false when the last item is removed.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: Shown under the heading when there are no items. Without it the section draws nothing when empty.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes an item. With it edit mode shows a remove button on each row, and each row offers a remove action to TalkBack.

options.name: onReorder
options.description: Receives the new order after a move. With it edit mode shows the rows as a MonarchReorderableList.

options.name: headingIcon
options.description: An icon before the heading, such as a star. Decorative.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: Makes the remove buttons icon buttons. Without it they show Remove.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Favorites, Edit, Edit favorites, Done, Remove, the remove name, the removal announcement and the reorderable list's strings.

states.name: browsing
states.description: Rows are NavigationDrawerItems with an optional icon and the name; the Edit button shows when onRemove or onReorder is given and there are items.

states.name: current
states.description: The current destination is selected, in semibold, in the strong accent text on the subtle accent fill.

states.name: editing
states.description: With onReorder the rows become a reorderable list with drag handles; with onRemove each row has a remove button; rows stop opening their destination; the button reads Done.

states.name: empty
states.description: With emptyMessage, the heading and the message in muted text; without it nothing is drawn.

appearance: The heading is in the label type and muted text. Rows are Material 3 navigation drawer items: transparent at rest in the default text color, the current one on the subtle accent fill in the strong accent text and semibold. The Edit, Done and Remove buttons are small ghost Monarch buttons. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web FavoritesList is a nav of links with an Edit button, a ReorderableList and remove buttons; iOS uses its List edit mode with the system delete control. Android has no list edit mode, so edit mode swaps the rows for MonarchReorderableList (long press and drag, or the handle's Move up and Move down actions) and adds remove buttons; outside edit mode removal is a TalkBack custom action rather than swipe to delete, which Material 3 navigation drawers do not use. Rows report onSelect instead of following an href. The iOS showsIcon flag is the headingIcon slot, because Monarch for Android bundles no star glyph. The web's FavoriteToggle is not a separate type: use FilledTonalIconToggleButton with a star icon (see ToggleButton). In edit mode the reorderable list is at most 384dp tall and scrolls inside itself, so the section can sit in a scrolling drawer sheet.
accessibility: The heading (icon and title) is one element with heading semantics; the icon is decorative.
Rows are Material 3 navigation drawer items named by the destination; the current one is selected and also semibold, so it is not shown by color alone.
The Edit button is named Edit favorites and is named Done while editing.
With onRemove each row has a TalkBack custom action, Remove Roadmap from favorites; in edit mode the remove buttons have the same name.
In edit mode with onReorder each row's handle is named Reorder and the title, with Move up and Move down actions, from MonarchReorderableList.
After a removal "Roadmap removed from favorites." is announced through a polite live region that stays in the tree.
Rows, the Edit button and the remove buttons have 48dp touch targets; names wrap at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: With neither onRemove nor onReorder there is no Edit button and no remove action.
Removing the last item ends edit mode (onEditingChange(false)); without emptyMessage the section then draws nothing.
Long names wrap; the Edit button stays at the end of the heading.
The section is a Column, not a lazy list: it is meant for a handful of favourites in a drawer. In edit mode with many items the reorderable list scrolls inside its 384dp.

examples.template:
MonarchFavoritesList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchFavoriteItem(
            {{items.0.label}},
            id = {{items.0.id}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.{{items.0.icon|pascal}}, contentDescription = null) },
            current = {{items.0.current}},
        ),
        MonarchFavoriteItem(
            {{items.1.label}},
            id = {{items.1.id}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.{{items.1.icon|pascal}}, contentDescription = null) },
        ),
        MonarchFavoriteItem(
            {{items.2.label}},
            id = {{items.2.id}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.{{items.2.icon|pascal}}, contentDescription = null) },
        ),
    ),
    onSelect = {},
    modifier = Modifier.width(256.dp),
)
